encoding: POST application/json,strictUTF8,max16384bytes,no duplicate/unknown keys, no Content-Encoding/Origin/Cookie/query/fragment; existing API canonical serialization and exact ES256/P1363; response fixed no-store/no-referrer/nosniff

operator_authorize.authentication: Existing requireAdminAuth bearer/HMAC; never ordinary djci_/djcs_/djce_ authority or Core pairing. Existing operator credential is confined to authorized operator.
operator_authorize.operation_id: Original UUIDv7 authorization operation,5min execution window/30s future skew. Original enrollment has a separate UUIDv7; no refresh.
operator_authorize.authorization_id: Opaque [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}, original planned authorization; cannot be reused/replaced after conflict/withdrawal
operator_authorize.enrollment: Exact existing closed issuer Enrolment v1; public JWK only, no private d, no operator credential/token. Additional widget-only bounds below.
operator_authorize.winning_response: HTTP200,success true,state authorized,credential_state available,replayed false,credential djce_+canonicalbase64url32randombytes. This authorizes only one enrollment, not push or human consent.
operator_authorize.repeat_response: Same original input after winning mint: HTTP202 successfalse,stateunknown,credential_stateunavailable,replayedtrue,NO credential; no replacement/random-token disclosure. Expired/changed/conflicting operations may be409. Unknown mint reply stays unknown.

consent.nonce: Canonical base64url32bytes from original current Core consent action; API persists nonce hash only
consent.action_id: Opaque id1..128 from original affirmative owner action; API hashes domain/install/generation/action as unique action key
consent.generation_id: Opaque id1..128 identifying SAME original Core RAM/service/custodian generation; not restored after restart
consent.plan_digest: lowercase64hex SHA256 of exact reviewed original plan. Not a permission by itself.
consent.expires_at_ms: Original hard epoch-millisecond expiry, strict safe integer, future and <=validation now+900000; Core must preserve and independently enforce original local wall+monotonic start/end, never arrival renewal. Grant expiry must be <=this expiry.
consent.actual_authority: Authenticated operator must evaluate genuine original current owner/tuple/plan before authorize. Core must originate this consent from actual explicit owner management, not generic JSON import/admin boolean/pairing/default startup.

bindings.key_thumbprint: Existing issuer canonical-domain public-key hash, not RFC7638
bindings.scope_digest: Existing issuer delegation scope digest, including JWK thumbprint and entire immutable enrollment subject/policy
bindings.token_storage: SHA256 UTF8 complete djce_ credential; constant-time digest comparison. Raw token returned only to original winning authorized operator and not persisted in outcomes/logs.
bindings.uniqueness: authorization ID, original authorization operation, nonce hash, action key, delegation ID and original enrollment operation remain unique/tombstoned; changed IDs cannot remint same original nonce/action. No pruning/restart renewal.

bounds.ticket_deadline: MIN(original consent expiry,original grant expiry,original authorization UUIDv7+300000,original enrollment UUIDv7+300000). It never changes on mint replay,redeem,read,restart or response.
bounds.producer_limits: These are restrictions, not grants; existing Core original validity/purpose/field-history and budgets remain independently required.

redeem.authentication: Authorization: Bearer djce_<43canonicalbase64urlchars> plus signature by SAME approved K1 P256 key; no operator secret in Core
redeem.signature: canonicalbase64url64byte rawP1363 ES256(SHA256); DER/other algorithms/wrong key/domain/path refused
redeem.signing_bytes: UTF8 canonical([djc-surface-enrollment/1,POST,/v1/push/surface/enrollment/redeem,payload]); signature excluded; authorization ID/complete consent/original enrollment are signed
redeem.before_commit: Recompute exact hashes; validate same opaque credential/JWK signature,available/nonrevoked/current original ticket and enrollment UUIDv7 window. Recheck original window/cancel after crypto awaits.
redeem.atomic_commit: One D1 batch claims the ticket, writes existing issuer operator ledger and delegation, and settles both outcomes. First claim checks original expiry against runtime clock AND actual SQLite unixepoch(subsec) clock; SQL error rolls back entire batch. No split consume/enrol or provider/capability issuance.
redeem.winning_response: HTTP200,success true,stateenrolled,replayedfalse,expiry exactly original GRANT expiry; check remaining ticket/delegation validity before reply. All fields compared to the original Core attempt. Response is actual server-HTTPS result, not signed/portable authorization.
redeem.repeat_or_unknown: No success replay; spent/revoked/expired/concurrent loser returns409,changedscope403,wrongcredential/signature401. No retry/newUUID/key/ticket/re-enrollment after possible send/unknown. No enrollment-status endpoint in v1; old issuer/status cannot repair this.
redeem.core_admission: Only same still-live explicit consent,private K1 handle,original generation,scope and original wall+monotonic deadline can accept actual response. Check current authority before/after HTTPS and final no-await fence. Create owner only on exact original positive reply; historical metadata cannot create one. Subsequent existing issuer challenge/issue/adoption separately enforce current live delegation.

operator_revoke.authentication: Existing privileged operator only; works after ticket expiry,with fresh bounded revocation UUIDv7; no K1 key/djce possession required
operator_revoke.early_revoke: Records durable revocation before authorization exists; delayed mint of SAME authorization ID denied
operator_revoke.after_enrollment: Does not withdraw an already-enrolled delegation. Existing separately authorized issuer/operator/withdraw is required and remains independent of lost K1 key. Ticket revocation never provides a broader revocation credential.
operator_revoke.concurrency: Revoke-before-claim blocks redemption; claim-before-revoke may already have enrolled. Do not promise retraction of completed enrollment.

private_transfer: Selected explicit authenticated owner-management action imports only opaque djce_ credential into SAME pending Core attempt. Never operator secret, arbitrary purpose/tuple JSON or automatic configuration/default startup. API admin call and private transfer facility need actual qualified owning implementation and separate effect approval; none is fabricated by this contract. Do not put real tokens/nonce/tuple in public GitHub inputs/logs/artifacts.
deployment: New internal handler is not imported/composed/routed by Worker. Existing compiled SURFACE_PUSH_HTTP_ENABLED=false reserves entire namespace with503 before credentials/body/env. Migration0011 is source only; never applied remotely here.
operational_grants: No K1 generation,K2 execution,enrollment,provider config/deploy/native or CI cancellation. Activity/external-content/update/end/start rights remain separately closed.
normal_gates: Joint exact contract review,local actual SQLite/crypto checks,independent exact whole source review,protected source/original own-main CI, separate Final and later exact admitted configuration/deployment/effect decision.
